CASH-001.title: Cashier leaves the workstation before customer service ends
required_evidence: The beginning of service, an unfinished transaction, the cashier's departure and the customer remaining are continuously visible.
The workstation zone has been defined in advance.
exceptions: Customer service has already finished.
The cashier bends down, reaches for equipment or is temporarily occluded by an object.
do_not_infer: Do not classify every departure as a violation outside customer service.

CASH-002.title: Storage of personal belongings in the cash handling area
required_evidence: The boundary of the cash handling area is established.
There is evidence that the item is personal and belongs to an employee, rather than a customer or cash collection service.
exceptions: Medicines, medical devices and communication devices without photo/video recording are permitted.
A cash collection bag is not a personal bag.
do_not_infer: Do not identify ownership by a person's face.
Do not classify every unknown object as a personal belonging.

CASH-003.title: Communication device with a camera in the cash handling area
required_evidence: The device and the area are visible.
Photo/video capability is confirmed by a visible camera or reliable device model information; a rectangular object alone is insufficient.
exceptions: A communication device without photo/video recording capability.
Bank equipment or a customer's digital document is not equivalent to an employee's personal phone.
do_not_infer: Using a phone alone does not establish filming, a data leak or data transmission.

CASH-004.title: Previously accepted cash remains outside designated storage devices
required_evidence: Continuous transaction history establishes which cash was previously accepted and which belongs to the current customer.
The work surface and storage locations are visible.
exceptions: Cash on the desk belongs to the current customer.
The stack's origin is unclear or the start of the transaction is outside the clip.
do_not_infer: Cash being on the desk is not by itself a violation.
A closed door does not prove that its lock is locked.

CASH-005.title: Accepting or counting cash without the customer present
required_evidence: This is confirmed to be accepting cash from a customer, rather than internal counting.
The entire area where the customer could be present is visible.
exceptions: The customer is outside the frame but may be nearby.
Internal handling after cash acceptance has finished.
do_not_infer: Absence from the frame is not equivalent to absence from the room.

CASH-006.title: Accepting banknotes without observable note-by-note counting
required_evidence: The entire cycle and all possible counting devices are visible.
For coins, assess counting individual coins.
exceptions: A counting machine or automated cash desk was used.
Counting may have happened before the clip began.
do_not_infer: The absence of a separate UV detector does not establish absence of authenticity checking.

CASH-008.title: Paying out cash without counting it in the customer's presence
required_evidence: The entire preparation and handover cycle is visible.
The packaging type and applicability of the exceptions in paragraph 32 are established.
exceptions: Undamaged full or incomplete bundles and individual banknote straps are paid out according to their marked amounts under paragraph 32.
Incomplete or damaged straps require note-by-note counting; coin packaging must also be considered.
do_not_infer: Do not require note-by-note counting for every sealed bundle.

CASH-010.title: Internal counting, sorting or packaging without a supervising employee
required_evidence: This is internal handling, rather than customer cash acceptance or payout.
The entire area where a supervisor could be present is visible.
The second employee's role is confirmed by role annotation, without facial identification.
exceptions: Customer acceptance and payout are explicitly excluded by paragraph 42.
The supervisor may be outside the frame.
do_not_infer: A second person in the frame is not necessarily a supervisor.

CASH-012.title: Mixing banknote categories during packaging
required_evidence: The cash category is confirmed by readable labeling or unambiguous visible damage.
Combining the categories into one package is visible.
exceptions: Ordinary movement before sorting.
Image quality does not permit the banknotes' condition to be determined.
do_not_infer: Do not determine wear or authenticity from an unreadable frame.

CASH-013.title: Completed banknote strap or bundle with a visible discrepancy
required_evidence: Denominations or required details can be read reliably, or the quantity can be tracked.
The formation operation is complete.
exceptions: Incomplete and mixed bundles are regulated separately by paragraphs 49-50.
Banknote quantities usually cannot be established with an overhead camera.
do_not_infer: Do not calculate quantity from a stack's thickness.

CASH-014.title: Visible defect in completed banknote packaging
required_evidence: The packaging method and defect are distinguishable.
Packaging is complete, rather than at an intermediate stage.
exceptions: A heat-sealed polyethylene bag with the required details is a permitted packaging method.
do_not_infer: Do not require a string seal in addition to an alternative permitted packaging method.

CASH-015.title: Defective coin-bag packaging
required_evidence: A coin bag is recognized and its packaging is complete.
The defect is distinguishable.
exceptions: A bag is simply open while it is being packed.
do_not_infer: Do not estimate coin quantity from bag volume.

CIT-002.title: Acceptance of defective packaging for transportation
required_evidence: This is acceptance for transportation under section 3.
The defect is visible and acceptance is complete.
exceptions: Defective packaging was rejected and replaced before acceptance.
Collecting proceeds and transportation between administrative units are different contexts.
do_not_infer: Do not apply paragraph 112 to every bag at a cash desk without checking the context.

CIT-003.title: Packaging for transportation without the sending customer present
required_evidence: This is the transportation procedure described in paragraphs 110-113.
The entire process and the entire area where the customer could be present are visible.
exceptions: The customer may be outside the frame.
do_not_infer: Do not apply this to every internal packaging operation by a cashier.

CIT-004.title: Access to or observation of cash loading by third parties
required_evidence: The loading area and cash collection stage are established.
The third party's role is confirmed without facial recognition.
exceptions: A security employee, cash collector or authorized employee is not equivalent to an outsider.
do_not_infer: Do not apply paragraph 21 to ordinary customer service at the cash desk.
